name: About Modal
description: Version/credits dialog. Displays app name, tagline, version (from electron API), Electron/Node version numbers, and a clickable 'UseDesign.md' link that opens an external URL. Close button and overlay click dismiss. Supports optional onClose callback.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show overlay, store onClose callback. Close via close button, overlay click, or onClose callback.
